name: step-budget
what: An agent is warned once when it nears its tool-call limit, then refused everything except reading, and each agent is counted on its own.

faults.fault: The warning is skipped, so an agent reaches the hard limit without being told.
Past the hard limit, editing and shell calls are no longer refused.
Two agents in one session share a counter.
Reading is refused past the limit, so the agent cannot look up what it needs for its hand-off.
The warning repeats on every call after the first.
